source_text.body:
Scan Zillow for fix-and-flip deals under $250k
An agent scans Zillow for listings under $250k with 50+ days on market and flags same-day updates, replacing manual checks several times a day.
·
Aug 7, 2026
Done with a
custom-built or unnamed agent
What they did
The poster set up a Hyperagent workflow to watch Zillow for homes under $250k that had been on market 50+ days, then flag them the same day Zillow data changed. The agent replaced manually checking listings 2–3 times a day with a prefiltered list the poster reviews in about five minutes; the human still evaluates properties, runs comps, walks houses, and manages renovations.
How it went
It cut a task that used to take about an hour a day down to a 5-minute scan. The poster says they have not closed a deal from it yet, but it surfaced two properties they do not think they would have found manually.
Worth knowing
The main catch is that the source gives no build details beyond using Hyperagent, so you can copy the filters and workflow goal more than the exact implementation.
Try it yourself
with
Perplexity Comet
Copy prompt
Search Zillow for [city/area] listings priced under [$ amount] that have been on the market [number]+ days. Give me a table with address, price, days on market, price changes and a link, and mark anything that's new or updated today. Don't contact any agents or submit any forms.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/Hyperagent/comments/1vi2xjm/built_an_ai_agent_to_auto_scan_zillow_for
